    Class TpSqlViewer

    Displays and runs one SQL example in a compact interface.

    Example

    <tp-sql-viewer></tp-sql-viewer>

    Tagname

    tp-sql-viewer

    Attr

    repository = "" - Directory containing a project to load.

    Attr

    src = "" - JSON project or sql source file to load. tp-playground-src-load Emitted after a project configured with src has loaded.

    tp-playground-src-load { src: string; project: TpProject } tp-playground-repository-load Emitted after a project configured with repository has loaded.

    Eventdetail

    tp-playground-repository-load { repository: string; project: TpProject }
